{{PAGENAME}} is a reward for [[Ms. Charm]]s final quest. It is one of the six key quest items required to activate [[Portal]]. 

After you discuss the Necklace with [[Koukol]], the player considers that the Necklace may never be found. Talk to [[Ms. Charm]] to continue the quest line.
